title: Method moved to the end of its class is named by the method
expected: Total moved (unchanged) below Clear; the Sem tab names it "Total", not the class "Order".

title: Method moved inside a nested class is named by the method
expected: Describe moved within Outer.Inner; named "Describe", not "Inner" or "Outer".

title: Property with a getter body moved is named by the property
expected: FullName moved to the end of Person; named "FullName", not "Person" or "get".

title: Two methods swapped; the smaller one is the move
expected: Small and Big swapped. Big stays as the unchanged anchor and Small is moved; the move is named "Small", not "Calculator". (A claim that names Big as moved instead is also a true move, but not this case's answer.)

title: Method moved to the end of a class in a file-scoped namespace: no stray added blank line or brace
expected: First moved below Third. The blank line before it and the class brace "}" after it are unchanged layout, not added; the blank line it left behind is not deleted.

title: Method moved to the end of a class in a block namespace: no stray added blank line or braces
expected: First moved below Third. The blank line before it and the class "    }" and namespace "}" braces after it are unchanged, not added; the blank it left behind is not deleted.

title: Last method moved to the top of its class: no stray added blank line or opening brace
expected: Third moved above First. The class "{" before it and the blank line after it are unchanged layout, not added; the blank line above its old place is not deleted.

title: Method renamed with its callers is named by the declaration
expected: renamed ComputeTotal -> CalculateTotal on the declaration and both call sites; named by the declaration, not by a call-site line or the callers Summary/OverLimit.

title: Rename where the call sites come before the declaration
expected: renamed FormatHeader -> BuildHeader; the first changed line is a call site in Render, but the name shown is the declaration's, not "Render" or "RenderEmpty".

title: Rename of an expression-bodied method used from another class in the file
expected: renamed CountOf -> QuantityOf (declaration, a call in InStock, a member call in Shelf.Label); named by the declaration, not "Label", "InStock" or "Shelf".

title: Overloads with one name: the string overload moved, paired by parameter types
expected: Format(string) moved below Format(double), unchanged. It must not be paired with Format(int) or Format(double) (that would be a movedWithEdit or edit between different overloads).

title: Method with /// docs and attributes moved: docs and attributes travel with it
expected: Fetch moved above Reset together with its four /// lines and two attributes; none of those lines is added or deleted.

title: Expression body => x turned into a block body { return x; }
expected: Edited, not reformatted: the tokens differ (=> and ; versus { return ; }), even though the result is the same.

title: Method moved between the two parts of a partial class in one file
expected: Area moved from the first part of partial Widget to the second; same class, same meaning, so moved.

title: Method moved into a new #region at the end of the class
expected: IsDigit moved into "#region Helpers"; moved, unchanged. The #region and #endregion lines are added and are not part of the move.

title: Method moved out of a #region to the end of the class
expected: Peek moved out of "#region Internals"; moved, unchanged. The region lines stay where they were and are not part of the move (and are not added or deleted).

title: Rename hides a changed argument on one call site
expected: renamed ComputeTotal -> CalculateTotal on the declaration and in Twice; the call in Single also changed 10m to 12m, so that line is an edit and must not be covered by the rename.

title: Static method moved from a class into its nested class
expected: Scale now lives in Shape.Units: its full name and every call change (Scaled now calls Units.Scale), so this is edited, not a plain move (the decided context rule).

title: Method moved and edited on the way (positive control for movedWithEdit)
expected: Balance moved below Post and += became -=: movedWithEdit, never a plain moved.
